summary: New nether biomes don t work properly in buffet worlds
description: The bug The new nether biomes (nether wastes, soul sand valley, crimson forest, warped forest and basalt deltas) do not work in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. To reproduce - Create New World - Select More World Options - Make a buffet world - Select Soul Sand Valley - Set terrain type to Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode Freezes the game before it even loads terrain (Image Below) -Surface mode creates a purely ocean world (This happened the first time i tried to make one but works fine now for some reason) The following list is updated in version 20w15a: Biomes All world generators that freeze the game Nether wastes Surface Crimson forest Surface Warped forest Surface and floating islands Soul sand valley Surface Basalt deltas Surface
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world.
3. Select "More World Options".
4. Make a buffet world.
5. Select "Soul Sand Valley".
6. Set terrain type to "Floating Islands" or "Surface".
7. Wait until the game attempts to load the terrain.
8. Observe that the game freezes before loading the terrain.
Observed Behavior: The new nether biomes, which include the nether wastes, soul sand valley, crimson forest, warped forest, and basalt deltas, do not function correctly when used in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. When attempting to create a new world, selecting the buffet world option and then choosing the soul sand valley while setting the terrain type to either Floating Islands or Surface Floating Islands leads to a game freeze before any terrain loads. In one instance, selecting the Surface mode resulted in a world that was entirely oceanic, although this issue resolved itself upon subsequent attempts. As of version 20w15a, the following biomes are known to cause freezing issues when generated in the specified world types: nether wastes in Surface, crimson forest in Surface, warped forest in both Surface and Floating Islands, soul sand valley in Surface, and basalt deltas in Surface.
Expected Behavior: When creating a buffet world and selecting any of the new nether biomes (such as Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, Nether Wastes, or Basalt Deltas), the game should successfully generate the chosen biome without freezing or crashing. Each selected biome should render correctly in both Surface and Floating Island modes, allowing players to explore and interact with the unique features and resources of the nether biomes as intended.
